name: Mahongwe
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Wikipedia (read) says only 'It is a tonal language'; no stress description; no grammar located on Glottolog/OLAC/SIL (not reachable by automated download)

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x langdoc reference list for maho1248 (15 entries) and BibTeX records 318611, 715879, 715155
sources.note: Bibliographic only; identifies the three phonological descriptions (Sima Mvé 1999, Mopita 2019, Koumbi Mabiti 2025) and Mokrani 2016 via the latter.

sources.citation: Koumbi Mabiti, Glenn Aymar. 2025. Phonologie diachronique des parlers du groupe Kota-Kele (B20) pour un affinement des embranchements internes. Thèse de doctorat, Université Omar Bongo, Libreville. 381 pp. HAL tel-04957912.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Mahongwe sketch §I.2.2.6 pp. 90-95 (pdf 91-96), phonology taken from Mokrani 2016: two tonemes /H/ and /B/ with distinctive function, a mid tone as realisation of H before pause, a downstepped H from H-H; no mention of stress/accent for Mahongwe. Only group-level remark p. 238: B20 dialects may be evolving 'vers un processus accentuel' (after Rekanga 2007:26, Dodo-Bouguendza 2010:78) because theme-final syllables are regularly low — not a word-stress statement.

sources.citation: Jacquot, André. 1983. Les classes nominales dans les langues bantoues des groupes B.10, B.20, B.30 (Gabon-Congo). Travaux et documents de l'ORSTOM 157. Paris: ORSTOM. 358 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Noun-class survey; Mahongwe appears only in speaker counts and affinity lists; zero hits for 'accent'; nothing on stress or tone for Mahongwe.
Only 'It is a tonal language'; no stress information, no cited grammar.

sources.citation: Mopita, Paterne. 2019. Étude phonétique et phonologique du mahongwè, langue du Gabon B(252). Mémoire de Master, Université Omar Bongo, Libreville.
